messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Wed, Nov 10, 2021, Rana Rehan Khalid wrote:
>
>I generated many rst files. In these rst files I have dna and
>nucleotide probs. I want to replace/remove the dna coordinates. Can I do
>this file processing through CPPTRAJ.
The strip command in cpptraj will allow you to remove the dna coordinates.
I'm not sure what you mean by "replace" in this context.
....dac
